name: ashui-components
description: Reusable HXX controls for ashui, with CSS styling and keyboard and pointer behaviors.
releasenote: Coordinated small, medium and large control sizes. Centered NumberInput values with optional step buttons and wheel stepping. New NumberGauge and NumberRangeGauge controls with compact SVG grips. Numeric editing preserves parent scroll and momentum ownership; dialogs support cancellable dismissal and form submission.
